name: agentscan
description: Find broken agent configuration in a project — hooks whose scripts are gone, MCP servers that cannot start, skills that disagree with their lockfile
author: Sima Alexandru <sima.alex33@gmail.com>

scripts.preinstall:
node -e "try{require('child_process').execSync('bun --version',{stdio:'ignore'})}catch{console.error('
  agentscan runs on Bun. Install it: https://bun.sh
  (the CLI will not start without it)
')}"
